results.title: 101 Dalmatians
results.overview: An evil, high-fashion designer plots to steal Dalmatian puppies in order to make an extravagant fur coat, but instead creates an extravagant mess.

results.title: 101 Dalmatians Christmas
results.overview: In Disney's fourth adaptation of Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol, Cruella de Vil appears in the role of Scrooge, Jasper and Horace as Marley, Cadpig as the ghost of Christmas Past, Rolly as the ghost of Christmas Present, and Spot as the ghost of Christmas Yet To Come.

results.title: Dalmatians 101
results.overview: Bonus short on the 101 Dalmatians Diamond Edition Blu-ray giving you the Disney 411 hosted by Cameron Bryce

results.title: PROGRESS Chapter 101: Dalmatians
results.overview: It’s a new decade, a new era and a new start in PROGRESS… but some things looked strangely familiar!

results.title: Disney Sing-Along Songs: Pongo & Perdita
results.overview: It's the day of the annual Bow-Wow Ball at the Dalmatian Plantation! Pongo, Perdita, and Nanny do their best to keep your favorite puppies from Disney's live-action hit, 101 Dalmatians, out of trouble before their friends arrive for the big party. Features a song from Disney's animated classic 101 Dalmatians.

results.title: 101 Dalmatians: The Further Adventures of Thunderbolt
results.original_title: 101 Dalmatians: The Further Adventures of Thunderbolt
results.overview: In Walt Disney's 101 Dalmatians, the puppies watch a black and white serial western TV show about Thunderbolt the Wonder Dog. That episode ends in a cliff hanger as Thunderbolt, in hot pursuit of Dirty Dawson, plunges into a river towards a treacherous waterfall. In this short episode that ties to the original, Thunderbolt escapes the fall down the waterfall with the help of the Sheriff, avoids an explosion triggered rock slide, and ultimately captures the horse thief, Dirty Dawson.

results.title: 101 Dalmatians: A Lesson in Self-Assertion
results.overview: The film teaches how to stand up to a bully through self-assertion.

results.title: 101 Dalmatians II: Patch's London Adventure
results.overview: Being one of 101 takes its toll on Patch, who doesn't feel unique. When he's accidentally left behind on moving day, he meets his idol, Thunderbolt, who enlists him on a publicity campaign.
